title: Mexican Coleslaw
ingredients: 8 cups coleslaw mix, shredded green and red cabbage with carrots
directions: Combine buttermilk, mayo, vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl or glass measuring cup.
In a very large bowl, combine cabbages, cilantro, onions, and jalapeno. Toss to combine.
Pour dressing over and toss. Chill salad about 20 min before serving.
Salad will reduce down quite a bit the longer it sits.
